description_en: Query the list of instance groups
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc list-iot-cloud-connector-groups --iot-cloud-connector-group-status Created --iot-cloud-connector-group-ids iotccg-g00epppbi9di9y0000 --iot-cloud-connector-group-name cctest --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --max-results 10 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --type Standard --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIoTCloudConnectorGroups

parameters.help_en:
The status of the instance groups. A maximum of 20 instance group statuses are supported. Valid values:
Creating: Creation in progress.
Created: Creation completed.
Deleting: Deletion in progress.
Updating: Update in progress
parameters.help_zh:
实例组的状态。最多支持20个实例组的状态。取值：
Creating：创建中。

Created：创建完成。

Deleting：删除中。

Updating：更新中
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_group_status

parameters.help_en: The list of instance group IDs. A maximum of 20 instance group IDs are supported
parameters.help_zh: 实例组的ID列表。最多支持20个实例组的ID列表
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The name of the instance group. A maximum of 20 instance group names are supported
parameters.help_zh: 实例组的名称。最多支持20个实例组的名称
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_group_name

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether a token for the next query exists. Valid values:
Do not specify this parameter for the first query or when there is no subsequent query.
If there is a subsequent query, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page when using batch queries. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值：1~50。默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region ID where the instance groups are located.

You can obtain the region ID by invoking the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html API
parameters.help_zh:
实例组所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The edition of the cloud connector instance. Different editions have different feature limitations and billing policies. Valid values:
Basic: Basic Edition.
Standard: Standard Edition.

<props="china">By default, cloud connector instances are created as Standard Edition. If you need to create a Basic Edition instance, submit a ticket (https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/category/ga/today) to request it.</props>

<props="intl">By default, cloud connector instances are created as Standard Edition. If you need to create a Basic Edition instance, submit a ticket (https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.11182188.console-base-top.dworkorder.18ae4882n3v6ZW#/ticket/createIndex) to request it.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例的版本，不同版本有不同功能限制和计费策略。取值：

Basic：基础版。

Standard：标准版。

<props="china">云连接器实例默认创建标准版，如果需要创建基础版实例，请提交工单 (https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/category/ga/today)申请。</props>
